summary.name: BLACKBOX.AI Chrome Extension
summary.one_liner: A Chrome browser extension that brings the BLACKBOX AI coding assistant into your browser for code questions, page-context Q&A, GitHub code chat, and screen OCR.
use_cases: Asking coding questions from the browser
Getting answers about the current web page
Getting explanations of code on GitHub
Extracting text from an image or screen region
summary.what_it_does: The extension opens an AI chat panel from the browser toolbar or a user-assigned keyboard shortcut. Users can ask coding questions and get real-time answers and suggestions. An "Include Context" option lets the assistant answer questions about the current page's content. When viewing code on GitHub, a "Code Chat" button appears above the code so users can ask questions about it. An OCR feature (Ctrl+E on Windows, Cmd+E on Mac) lets users select a screen zone and paste the recognized text.
notable: GitHub Code Chat button on code views
Page context toggle for asking about the current web page
OCR screen-region capture to text via Ctrl+E / Cmd+E
caveats: Pricing and any paid tiers are not stated on the page
